body.name: Global blocked-state BIC
body.construction: For each \(E\in\mathfrak S_p\), set \(d_E=p+\sum_{j\in V}|\Pi^E_j|\). On the measurable event \(S_n\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), compute \(L_E(S_n)\) using the block-design systems in \(\texttt{def:off-model-block-ls}\). For each target set \(\widehat\omega_{Ej}=S_{n,jj}-h_{Ej}(S_n)^{\mathsf T}\Gamma_{Ej}(S_n)^{-1}h_{Ej}(S_n)\), with \(\widehat\omega_{Ej}=S_{n,jj}\) for an empty parent set. Positive definiteness of \(S_n\) makes every nonempty \(\Gamma_{Ej}(S_n)\) positive definite and every \(\widehat\omega_{Ej}\) strictly positive, so the Gaussian likelihood supremum is finite and attained and \[\operatorname{BIC}_n(E)=-2\sup_{\Sigma\in\mathcal M(E)}\ell_n(\Sigma)+d_E\log n.\] On \(S_n\notin\mathbb S^p_{++}\), invoke no Gram inverse, residual-variance formula, or likelihood supremum and set \(\operatorname{BIC}_n(E)=d_E\log n\). For every \(n\in\mathbb N\), let \(\widehat C_n\) be the minimizer over \(\mathfrak S_p\) selected by a fixed deterministic ordering of states.
